blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents.
Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training.
Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames.
Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on ∼ \sim 1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures.
We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM’s outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as F 1 m ​ a ​ c ​ r ​ o F_{1}^{macro} .
Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics.
The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics.
Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.
blocks.zh:
电子游戏提供了可伸缩的环境,用于在体现的物剂中研究知觉和控制.
丰富多彩的在线游戏游戏视频可以提供演示,但很少包括玩家对训练的投入.
因此,建议采用反向动态模型(IDMs)从框架推断投入。
大(最多1B参数) 在\\im 1K-2K 游戏播放时数上接受过训练的IDM显示了这个尺度的可行性和跨环境的概括性,但研究者并没有澄清关键组件是什么来恢复单个动作,并且经常只报告能够掩盖稀有动作失败的集合精度.
我们用数据约束的情景来研究这个问题,以评估空间运动特征、模型结构以及培训目标如何影响IDM的结果,并分析我们的模型,如F 1 m a c r o F_{1}^{macro }按每个键和平衡的度量标准。
我们在Trackmania的实验强调了模型架构和在预处理中运动流提取等因素的重要性,同时也通过不平衡的度量来显示评价的极限.
同样的架构和培训配方应用于Cyberpunk 2077,揭示了整个游戏力学的不均匀性能.
我们的每个动作评价和故障分析突出了相机运动的模糊性、延迟效应和不平衡的按键压力频率,这些频率要求明确模拟3D场景结构、长期状态以及在今后的执行中采用适当的损失。

blocks.en: Beyond their commercial importance, video games are used as testbeds for perception, sequential decision making and embodied control [ 4 ] [ 13 ] [ 17 ] . Learning from gameplay requires pairs of frames and actions issued by human or digital players to train agents with methods like Behavioral Cloning (BC) [ 2 ] , Reinforcement Learning (RL) [ 21 ] , or to gain understanding of visual-motor control.
blocks.zh: 除了其商业重要性外,电子游戏还被用作感知、顺序决策和体现控制的试验床[4][13][17]。 从游戏游戏中学习,需要人类或数字玩家发布的对帧和动作来训练特工使用行为克隆(BC)[2],强化学习(RL)[21]等方法,或获得对视觉运动控制的理解.

blocks.en:
Despite abundant gameplay videos available on the internet, only a few of these are annotated with Keyboard and Mouse (KBM) actions.
Manual annotation at scale is practically impossible, whereas the acquisition of new datasets with frames labeled with KBM data is costly and time consuming.
Therefore we study the possibility of automatically annotating such videos with KBM labels.
The problem is far from trivial for several reasons, including actions with delayed effects (e.g., inertia affecting camera motion without any steady input); also, different actions may produce the same visual results, whereas certain actions may produce poorly visible features (e.g., a car turning while driving against a wall).
Additionally, the action distribution may be highly imbalanced (see Fig. 1 ).
Disentangling camera motion from character motion is yet another complication.
blocks.zh:
尽管互联网上有大量的游戏播放视频,但其中只有少数有键盘和鼠标(KBM)动作的注释.
小规模的人工注释实际上是不可能的,而购买带有KBM数据标签的框框的新数据集是昂贵和费时的。
因此,我们研究用KBM标签自动标注这些视频的可能性。
问题远非微不足道,原因有几个,包括有延迟效应的行动(如惯性影响相机运动而没有任何稳定的输入);另外,不同的行动可能产生相同的视觉效果,而某些行动则可能产生不明显的特征(如一辆车在逆墙行驶时转弯).
此外,动作分布可能高度不平衡(见图1)。
将相机运动与人物运动分开是另一个复杂因素.

blocks.en:
Existing works establish this idea at scale.
VPT [ 2 ] is a 0.5B parameter IDM trained on 1,962 hours of labeled Minecraft data and used to annotate 70K hours of web video.
D2E [ 7 ] uses a generalist model with 1B parameters trained on 1.3K hours of data (259 hours of human demonstration, 1K hours of pseudo-labeled gameplay).
These systems recover broad KBM action spaces and demonstrate the value of scale, but the question we intend to answer is deliberately smaller: before broad action recovery, how well can we recover navigation inputs from purely visual data? By answering this we highlight constraints that may become significant at a larger scale and in applications such as: annotation of online recordings, latency correction in poorly controlled acquisition setups, or the adoption of KBM annotation as an auxiliary task in complex training scenarios.
blocks.zh:
现有工作在规模上确立了这一想法。
VPT[2]是一个0.5B参数IDM,经过1,962小时的标注Minecraft数据培训,并用于注释70K小时的网络视频.
D2E [7] 使用带有1B参数的通论模型,在1.3K小时的数据(259小时的人类演示,1K小时的伪标签游戏)上训练.
这些系统恢复了宽广的KBM行动空间,并展示了规模的价值,但我们打算回答的问题却刻意小一些:在广泛行动恢复之前,我们如何从纯粹的视觉数据中恢复导航输入? 通过回答这一点,我们强调了在更大范围和应用中可能变得重要的制约因素,如:在线录音的注释、控制不良的购置装置的暂时性校正,或采用KBM注释作为复杂培训情景中的辅助任务。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: 1. For Trackmania, a 3 r ​ d 3^{rd} person view and mechanics video game, we isolate the effects of different factors (including frame resolution, use of pretrained embeddings, loss terms and prediction size) and highlight that model architecture, optical flow in input, and contrastive learning provide the most significant advantages. 2. We highlight the importance of adopting per-key and unweighted metrics for proper evaluation of IDMs. 3. We identify limitations, open problems, and guidelines for future research by applying the same model and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 ( 1 s ​ t 1^{st} person view). We analyze, on both games, the spatial action-query attention map, to show, for instance, the importance of equipping the IDM with the capability of disentangling the camera motion from character motion.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large-Scale IDMs and Action-Level Evaluation:
blocks.zh: 大型综合管理和行动级评价:

blocks.en:
Latent-action IDM techniques remove the labeled corpus altogether: for instance, LAPO [ 19 ] trains a latent IDM and forward model jointly on 8M action-free Procgen frames; Genie [ 6 ] scales this approach to 30K hours of video with a 300M-parameter latent model.
Both recover a learned action space, later mapped using expert labels, rather than true actions: in other words, the reconstructed set of actions guarantees that the agent behaves like in the training examples, not that the set of key-presses is the same.
Here we tackle a complementary question: when the action space is fixed and discrete, how accurately can true key-presses be recovered? In this, we are closer to D2E [ 7 ] , a 1B-parameter generalist agent trained on 259 hours of human demonstration and 31 games plus 1K hours of pseudo-labeled gameplay, scored on 50 ms non-overlapping event bins.
When zero-shot on unseen titles, its keyboard accuracy falls to 63% (Battlefield 6) and 28% (Ogu and the Secret Forest): scale alone does not solve the key-press reconstruction problem.
blocks.zh:
例如,LAPO[19]在8M无动作的Procgen帧上联合培训一个潜在的IDM和前进模型;Genie[6]将这一方法比照30K小时的视频,采用300M参数的潜在模型。
两者都恢复了一个学习到的动作空间,后来使用专家标签来映射,而不是真实的动作:换句话说,被重建的一组动作保证了代理人在训练实例中的行为相似,而不是组合的密钥压力是相同的.
在这里,我们处理一个互补的问题:当行动空间固定和离散时,如何准确恢复真正的按键压力? 在此,我们更接近D2E [7],一个1B参数通用化的特工接受了259小时的人类演示和31场游戏加上1K小时的伪标签游戏,在50ms非重叠事件桶上得分.
当未见标题上的零镜头时,其键盘精度下降至63%(Battlefield 6)和28%(Ogu and the Secret Forest):光是比例并不能解决按键压力重建问题.

blocks.en:
We also found that the quantitative evaluation of IDMs is often aggregated over keys: VPT reports a single 90.6% key-press accuracy; D2E reports one keyboard accuracy per game.
Per-class breakdowns are rare, and mostly reserved to world-model controllability or GUI-agent evaluations [ 9 , 25 , 16 ] . When reported, the variance is severe: MineWorld’s per-action F1 ranges from ∼ 0.50 \sim 0.50 ( drop ) to ∼ 0.80 \sim 0.80 ( forward/backward ).
In VideoAgentTrek, F1 for press is 0.14 0.14 , for scroll it reaches 0.86 0.86 , but aggregation over all actions has F ​ 1 = 0.78 F1=0.78 .
In other words, aggregation hides variance when the majority label dominates.
This aspect should not be neglected in training and evaluation: in Trackmania (Fig. 1 a), W ( forward ) is 4 × 4\times more frequent than A/D ( left / right ), therefore an always-press-W predictor scores well on the aggregate while failing on rarer actions.
For this reason we study per-key metrics both for training and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们还发现,对IMDM的定量评价常常是按以下各点汇总的: VPT只报告一个90.6%的按键精度;D2E每局报告一个键盘精度.
每类分解很少见,大多保留给世界模型可控性或GUI代理评价[9,25,16]. 当报告时,差异是严重的:MineWorld的每个动作F1从 0.50\sim 0.50(下降)到 0.80\sim 0.80(向前/后退)。
在视频代理中 Trek,F1的按键为0.14 0.14,卷轴为0.86 0.86,但所有动作的汇总为F 1=0.78 F1=0.78.
换言之,当大多数标签占主导地位时,聚合会隐藏差异。
在培训和评价中不应忽略这一方面:在Trackmania(图1a),W(前方)比A/D(左/右)更频繁地出现4×4\的频率,因此,一个总按压-W的预测器在总分上得分良好,而在少见的行动上则失败。
为此,我们研究了用于培训和评估的每个关键衡量标准。

blocks.en:
Researchers in robotics face a similar recovery problem for continuous actions: H2O [ 10 ] and OKAMI [ 13 ] fit a parametric body model to human video, then retarget the estimated pose to humanoid joint angles.
Because that target is itself an estimate, it is validated by downstream task success rather than compared with ground truth; our labels are key-presses, so predictions are scored directly.
blocks.zh:
机器人领域的研究人员面临类似的连续动作的恢复问题:H2O[10]和OKAMI[13]将一个参数化的身体模型适合人类视频,然后将估计的姿势重新瞄准人类的关节角.
由于这个目标本身就是一个估计,它通过下游任务的成功来验证,而不是与地面的真理比较;我们的标签是按键压,所以预测直接得分.

blocks.en: Motion, Temporal and Semantic Space Design:
blocks.zh: 运动、时间和语义空间设计:

blocks.en:
Visual dynamics in games are complicated by 3D scene structure, elements that do not follow scene physics (such as HUD overlays) or real physics (such as magic items), and by the entanglement of the camera and character motion.
To provide better motion understanding to our model, we test augmentation of the RGB input with RAFT optical flow, which encodes estimated per-pixel displacement between adjacent frames.
Its all-pairs correlations and iterative refinement capture large camera and character motions, offering direct cues for key-press prediction [ 22 ] .
We also study architectures that are specifically designed to handle videos and, as a consequence, motion.
In particular, we compare two model families: video transformers such as ViViT [ 1 ] and TimeSformer [ 5 ] that apply joint or factorized space-time attention to patch or tubelet tokens; and Hybrid models using a convolutional stem to extract local features and downsample H × W H\times W inputs before tokenization [ 24 , 8 ] .
To handle the complex semantics of video games, we also test whether pretrained DINOv3 embeddings [ 20 ] (ViT-S/16) transfer to key-press estimation.
Lastly, BCE used by prior IDMs [ 2 , 7 ] can underperform on imbalanced and sparse multi-label targets, so we compare it with adaptive asymmetric loss [ 18 ] , soft-F1 [ 3 ] , and action-supervised contrastive initialization [ 11 ] as alternative training objectives.
blocks.zh:
游戏中的视觉动力学由于3D场景结构,元素不跟随场景物理(如HUD overlays)或真物理(如魔法物品),镜头和人物运动的缠绕而变得复杂.
为了对我们的模型提供更好的运动理解,我们用RAFT光学流来测试RGB输入的增强,这个光学流编码了相邻帧之间估计的每像素迁移.
它的全pairs相关性和迭代精度捕捉大相机和人物运动,为按键压力预测提供了直接提示 [22].
我们还研究专门用来处理视频的建筑,并因此进行运动。
特别是,我们比较了两个模型家族:像ViViT [1]和TimeSformer [5]这样的视频变压器,它们将联合或因子化的时空注意力应用到补丁或管状符号上;以及混合型模型,使用转录干来提取局部特征和下采样 H×W H\times W输入在标记化前[24,8].
为了处理电子游戏的复杂语义,我们还测试是否预先训练的DINOv3嵌入[20](ViT-S/16)转录到按键压力估计.
最后,以往的IDM[2,7]使用的BCE可能会在不平衡和稀疏的多标签目标上表现不佳,因此我们把它与适应性不对称损失[18],软F1[3]以及动作监督对比初始化[11]作为替代培训目标进行比较.

3.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en:
We use 2 gameplay datasets: the first one comprises Trackmania recordings, a 3 r ​ d 3^{rd} person driving video game; the second one comprises Cyberpunk 2077, a 1 s ​ t 1^{st} person navigation video game (see Fig. 1 ).
Frames were captured at 20Hz and 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution. The size and splits of the two datasets are shown in Table 1 .
Models are trained and evaluated per game without mixing datasets, using only sequences with active gameplay. Each split is sampled from different recordings.

blocks.en: Optimization

blocks.en:
All experiments run on 1 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU and use BF16 autocasting, with losses computed in FP32. We use AdamW [ 15 , 12 ] with weight decay 0.1 0.1 and learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} ; 5 linear warm-up epochs are followed by CosineAnnealingLR [ 14 ] to 10 − 7 10^{-7} . Batch size is 128, dropout is 0.1 0.1 , and each RGB or optical-flow input element is independently masked with probability 0.20 0.20 . Ground-truth key states are always masked and are never provided to the model as input.
Training is performed for a number of epochs between 45 and 100, with validation computed at each epoch.
The model checkpoint with the highest validation macro- F 1 F_{1} is saved for inference.

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation study (primary factors)
blocks.zh: 3.4 发育研究(主要因素)

blocks.en:
In our experiments we have found three factors emerging as the main ones affecting the model’s capability to label each frame with the correct set of pressed keys.
These are (i) the model architecture, (ii) the additional optical flow channels in input, and (iii) the contrastive training objective: these are described here.
Experiments on other factors with minor effects on the final result (i.e., frame resolution, BCE and asymmetric loss, pretrained embeddings) are detailed in Appendix 0.A .

在我们的实验中,我们发现有三个因素正在成为影响模型用正确的一组按键给每个框架贴标签能力的主要因素。
它们是(一)模型结构,(二)投入中的额外光学流渠道,以及(三)对比性培训目标:这里介绍这些.
附录0.A详细介绍了对最终结果有轻微影响的其他因素(即框架分辨率、BCE和不对称损失、预先训练的嵌入)。

blocks.en: Additional motion flow in input
blocks.zh: 输入的其他运动流量

blocks.en:
Optical flow can be provided as an additional input channel.
The rationale is that clean motion information in input may be used by the model to reconstruct the character and camera motion and thus facilitate the estimate of the key-presses in the input sequence.
We use a RAFT-Large [ 23 ] model to compute the motion (dx, dy) for each of the 4 adjacent frame pairs (for T i ​ n = 5 T_{in}=5 ), and concatenate the resulting 8 channels with the RGB data.
Our HT-RGBF-E2E model shares the same architecture as the HT-RGB model, but has 23 23 input channels ( 4 4 flow fields, 8 8 channels) instead of 15 15 .
It also has a comparable ( ∼ 31.5 \sim 31.5 M parameters) size.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: 5.1 Positive Results and Design Implications
blocks.zh: 5.1 积极成果和设计影响

blocks.en:
Our main finding is that the spatiotemporal ViT outperforms traditional CNNs, while the HT architecture coupled with optical flow and contrastive initialization forms the strongest combination studied.
Our intuition is that the optical flow helps the model disentangle complex motion features (such as those created by camera motion/inertia while the playable character moves) while contrastive initialization helps build a more reliable embedding space- especially when training from scratch.
The embeddings learned on a target game mechanic (like navigation) or environment are likely more focused than general pretrained embeddings, as shown in the Appendix when comparing against a model trained with frozen DINOv3.
Our experiments confirm that using accuracy Acc . \mathrm{Acc.} in evaluation can hide minority-key errors because inactive (or always-on) keys may dominate it.
Further experiments in the Appendix seem to indicate that a balanced metric should be used for training as well (in fact we use a soft-F1 instead of BCE loss), but the numerical evidence is not sufficient to fully support this statement: more tests are needed to confirm it.
Our findings also indicate (see Appendix) that higher frame resolution provides small (yet consistent) improvements in performance, at the cost of higher compute.
Nonetheless, we decide to (and suggest future researchers to) work at the highest resolution to standardize subsequent models and avoid a resolution bottleneck in detail-heavy games like Cyberpunk.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要发现是 spatiotemporal ViT 超越了传统的CNN, 而HT架构 结合光学流 和对比初始化 构成研究的最强组合。
我们的直觉是,光学流有助于模型分解复杂的运动特征(如可玩性角色移动时由相机运动/内线所创造的特征),而对比初始化则有助于建立更可靠的嵌入空间——特别是从零开始训练时.
在目标游戏机师(类似导航)或环境上学习的嵌入可能比一般的预先训练的嵌入更突出重点,如附录所示,与训练有冻DINov3的模型相比.
我们的实验证实,在评价中使用精确 Acc .\ mathrm{Acc.} 可以隐藏少数键错误,因为不活动(或总是)键可能支配它。
附录中的进一步试验似乎表明,培训也应该使用平衡的衡量标准(实际上我们使用软F1而不是BCE损失),但数字证据不足以充分证明这一说法:需要更多的测试来证实这一点。
我们的调查结果还表明(见附录),较高的框架分辨率在业绩方面提供了小幅(仍然是一致的)改进,而计算成本较高。
然而,我们决定(并建议未来的研究人员)以最高的分辨率开展工作,使随后的模型标准化,并避免像Cyberpunk那样在详细的游戏中出现分辨率瓶颈。

blocks.en: 5.2 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 5.2 限制和未来方向

blocks.en:
When compared against models trained for BC (and thus learning a reliable, average policy to predict the next key-presses) on the same game, we found that our IDMs achieve only slightly superior performance.
For instance, a CNN model successfully trained to play Trackmania typically achieves F 1 , W ∼ 0.9 F_{1,W}\sim 0.9 and F 1 , A ∼ F 1 , D ∼ 0.8 F_{1,A}\sim F_{1,D}\sim 0.8 , whereas our best IDM (see Table 2 ) achieves 0.920 0.920 , 0.869 0.869 , and 0.870 0.870 on the same metrics.
Our interpretation is that the IDM may partly learn the dataset’s average policy rather than a precise visual-to-key mapping.
This interpretation requires further validation but motivates larger, more diverse datasets, as in VPT and D2E, to avoid regression toward the average policy. However, scale alone cannot remove visual ambiguity: gameplay projects 3D motion into 2D, while the camera moves independently.
Optical flow measures displacement, not its cause; a reversing vehicle can coincide with forward camera motion, while weapons and HUD overlays are independent of navigation.
Explicit 3D scene and ego-motion modeling may therefore be required to disentangle these dynamics and further improve IDM performance. This may aid the learning of player motion (and thus the reconstruction of the controlling key-presses) independently from that of the camera.
blocks.zh:
当与为BC训练的模型(从而学习一个可靠的,平均的政策来预测下一个按键压)比较时,我们发现我们的IDM只取得了略高的性能.
例如,有线电视新闻网成功训练出播放Trackmania的模型通常能达到F 1、W 0.9 F_{1、W}\sim 0.9和F 1、A F 1、D∼0.8 F_{1、A}\sim F_{1、D}\sim 0.8,而我们最好的IDM(见表2)则达到0.920 0.920、0.869 0.869和0.870 0.870。
我们的解释是,IDM可能部分地学习数据集的平均政策,而不是精确的直观到键映射.
这种解释需要进一步验证,但如VPT和D2E中那样,促使更大的、更多样化的数据集避免向平均政策倒退。 然而,光是规模无法消除视觉模糊:游戏游戏项目3D运动到2D,而相机独立移动.
光学流能测量迁移,而不是其原因;反向飞行器可以与前置相机运动同步,而武器和HUD重叠则独立于导航.
因此,可能需要明确的3D场景和自我运动模型来分解这些动态,进一步提高IDM的性能. 这可能有助于玩家运动的学习(从而独立于相机的控制键压的重建).

blocks.en:
We also highlight that certain key-presses produce little or no immediate visual evidence, making reconstruction ambiguous from pixels alone (Figures 3 and 5 ). For example, steering into a wall may leave vehicle position and orientation unchanged except for a subtle wheel-angle change. Such a press is irrelevant only if it has no later consequence: inertia, limited-resource consumption, or adding an item to an inventory can alter latent game state without becoming visible within a T T -frame context. Recovering these partially observable actions, when possible, may require a longer context, explicit state memory, and high resolution to capture minute visual details.
These aspects should be taken into careful consideration for future research in this direction.
blocks.zh:
我们还强调,某些按键压产生的即时视觉证据很少或根本没有,仅从像素上就使得重建变得模糊不清(图3和图5)。 例如,进入墙壁的转向可能使车辆的位置和方向保持不变,除非发生微妙的轮角变化。 只有当没有以后的后果时,这种压力才无关紧要:惯性、有限资源消耗或将一个项目添加到清单中,可以改变潜在的游戏状态,而不会在T-Frame上下文中显现出来。 恢复这些部分可观察到的行动,如果可能的话,可能需要较长的上下文,明确的状态记忆,以及高分辨率来捕捉分钟的视觉细节.
今后在这方面的研究应认真考虑这些方面。

blocks.en: As explained in Section 3.4 , we detail here additional ablation studies on factors that experimentally had minor, no, or negative impact on the model performance. These are: (i) frame resolution, (ii) pretrained embeddings, and (iii) loss functions.
blocks.zh: 如第3.4节所解释的,我们在此详述关于实验性对模型性能有轻微、没有或消极影响的因素的补充研究。 它们是:(一) 框架分辨率,(二) 预先训练的嵌入,(三) 损失函数。

blocks.en: Frame Resolution:
blocks.zh: 框架分辨率 :

blocks.en:
We evaluated a CNN variant, named CNN-128, that takes 128 × 128 128\times 128 input frames instead of the 512 × 512 512\times 512 frames used by CNN-512.
The architectures are otherwise identical, and both models have 16,685 16{,}685 parameters; the comparison therefore isolates input resolution.
Rows 1 and 2 of Table 4 compare the performance of the two architectures, showing a small (yet consistent) advantage for the higher resolution input frames, as expected.
This suggests working at the highest possible resolution, without (on the other hand) increasing the frame resolution beyond a certain limit when compute is an important factor.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了一个CNN的变体,命名为CNN-128,它需要128×128\时128的输入帧,而不是CNN-512使用的512×512\时512帧.
建筑结构在其他方面是完全相同的,两个模型都有16,685 16{,}685个参数;因此比较会隔离输入分辨率.
表4第1行和第2行比较了两个架构的性能,显示了对更高分辨率输入帧的微小(相持)优势,如预期.
这表明在尽可能高的分辨率下工作,当计算是一个重要因素时,不会(另一方面)将框架分辨率超过一定限度。

blocks.en: Pretrained Embeddings:
blocks.zh: 预训嵌入 :

blocks.en:
We evaluated a ViT variant, named ViT-DINO-512, taking in input 512 × 512 512\times 512 (like ViT-E2E-512) and computing embeddings on the 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches using DINOv3 [ 20 ] .
While ViT-E2E-512 learns its patch projection end-to-end, the DINOv3 ViT-S/16 backbone in ViT-DINO-512 is frozen, removing 1 class and 4 register tokens before the common encoder.
Rows 3 and 4 of Table 4 compare the performance of the two models trained with the exact same recipe and show no clear advantage for DINOv3 embeddings over the ones that are learned end-to-end.
This result seems to discourage the adoption of embedders pretrained on real-world data for video game scenarios, where the visual features may be largely different from typical scenes observed in the real world.
Since numerical differences are small, however, such a conclusion should be taken with a grain of salt: more experiments on different seeds and different games may be needed to draw a reliable conclusion.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了一个名为ViT-DINO-512的ViT变体,采用输入式512×512\times 512(类似ViT-E2E-512),并使用DINOv3 [20]在16×16\times 16补丁上嵌入计算.
虽然ViT-E2E-512学习了它的补丁投影端对端,但ViT-DINO-512的DINOv3 ViT-S/16骨干却被冻结,在普通编码器之前取消了1类和4个注册符.
表4第3行和第4行将训练的两个模型的性能与完全相同的食谱进行比较,并显示DINOv3嵌入在学习到的端到端之间没有明显的优势.
这一结果似乎劝阻采用预先在现实世界数据上训练的嵌入器进行电子游戏场景,视觉特征可能与现实世界所观察到的典型场景基本不同.
然而,由于数字差异很小,因此应该用一粒盐来得出这样的结论:可能需要对不同的种子和不同的游戏进行更多的实验才能得出可靠的结论.

blocks.en: Loss Functions:
blocks.zh: 函数丢失 :

blocks.en:
We evaluated the effect of adopting different loss functions in training on the HT architecture.
In the ablation study, we compare this against the traditional BCE loss and an adaptive asymmetric loss (denoted as BCE A {{}^{\text{A}}} ), which penalizes false predictions ( F ​ P k FP_{k} and F ​ N k FN_{k} ) more for rarer keys: the BCE loss is multiplied by a factor of 25 25 when the key frequency is < 0.10 <0.10 , 20 20 for frequency in the [ 0.10 , 0.50 ) [0.10,0.50) interval, and 5 5 otherwise.
The last row of Table 4 shows the corresponding model (HT-RGB-ASYM).
Also in this case, the performance differences for the same model trained with the same recipe and different loss functions are minor and therefore more experiments on different seeds and different games may be needed to draw a reliable conclusion.
Nonetheless, the metrics suggest a slight advantage for the soft-F1 loss, especially for the rarer S ​ p Sp key, as introduced in the main paper. This explains why we adopted it as our preferred choice.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了在HT架构培训中采用不同的损失功能的影响。
在减速研究中,我们将此与传统的BCE损失和适应性不对称损失(BCE A {text{A}}}})相比较,后者惩罚了更稀有的密钥的假预测(F P k FP_{k}和F N k FN_{k}):当密钥频率 < 0.10 < 0.10 时,BCE损失乘以25 25倍,在[0.10,0.50]间隔时,频率为20倍,在[0.10,0.50]间隔时为5倍。
表4最后一行显示相应的模型(HT-RGB-ASYM).
同样在这种情况下,受过相同食谱和不同损失功能训练的同一型号的性能差异很小,因此可能需要更多不同种子和不同游戏的实验才能得出可靠的结论.
尽管如此,衡量标准表明软-F1损失略微有利,特别是主要论文中介绍的稀有S p Sp键。 这解释了为什么我们采用它作为我们的首选。
